about.subtitle: Safi Life connects people, products and entrepreneurial opportunities.
about.missionDesc: We create a platform where every partner can grow sales, build a team and receive support at every stage. Our goal is to let people use quality domestic products while building a stable and transparent business.
about.pathDesc: Safi Life's main market is Kazakhstan. We plan to expand to other CIS countries, opening new opportunities for current and future partners.

marketing.subtitle: A transparent reward system for your success
marketing.bonus1_desc: Paid for every personal invitation. Depends on your starter package from 10% to 20%.
marketing.bonus2_desc: Paid from the smaller branch turnover. Depends on the package from 7% to 10%. No cuts: points move to the next period.
marketing.bonus3_desc: Earn a percentage from binary bonuses of your personally invited partners.

faq.subtitle: Answers to popular questions about the company and business
faq.q1: Is it mandatory to sell products?
faq.q1Desc: No, you can build a consumer network and earn through the marketing system without direct sales.
faq.q2: Can I upgrade the package later?
faq.q2Desc: Yes, you can upgrade your status at any time by paying the package price difference.
